about: Packages whose published advisories are known and waited on, each until a date. After the date the audit check fails again. See tools/lib_audit.js.

waivers.reason: 2.5.1 has published advisories (fixed in 3.x and 4.x). The app only makes a PDF of your own trip with it. Upgrading needs the package registry and the new file's integrity hash, which the session that added this check could not reach.
Comes only with jsPDF's package (for its html() method, which the app does not use); it is not shipped to the browser. Goes away with the jsPDF upgrade.

GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579 (fixed in 6.4.1) is in the attribution control, which writes attribution text as HTML. The app creates its map with attributionControl: false (lib/vtmap.js) and uses no popups, so that code never runs here. 4.7.1 to 6.x is a major upgrade to plan and test.
